context: Sho and Hina paint pictures in art class.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Bright, curious leap into the room. Open vowels on 「Sho」. Genuine interest, no performance — the natural urgency of an eight-year-old who sees something happening and wants in.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Soft, almost to himself. Small proud smile audible. Doesn't look up from the page. The gentle certainty of a six-year-old focused on what matters in front of him.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: That's amazing! You're working so hard!
lines.style: Genuine delight, not exaggerated. The warmth of real recognition. Quick rhythm, breathless enthusiasm — she means every word and wants him to know it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: What are you going to draw?
lines.style: Quiet invitation, almost shy. A small turn toward her. The careful politeness of asking if he can invite someone into his world.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Let's draw something together! That'll be fun!
lines.style: Light, generous opening. Immediate warmth and inclusion. A child offering the simplest and most sincere gift — to make something with someone she likes.
